mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 105.0), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions with monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), high GDP levels (GDPC1 > 16000) signal profit-taking in equities, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and GDPC1 > 16000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
